target_customer: Real estate brokerages and agents in Latin America, starting in Mexico
problem: Brokerages and agents lack integrated software for listings, CRM, valuation and analytics, and agents feel their brokerage brand adds little for them.
business_model: Commission share on transactions (stated target of 20 percent of commissions) plus SaaS tools for brokers

founders.name: Matias Gath
previous_startups: Kadabra (on-demand delivery in Argentina, acquired by Glovo)
founders.background_notes: Third time founder per YC page; led Glovo's launch in Argentina.

founders.name: Agustin Iglesias
previous_startups: Tokko Broker (real estate CRM in Argentina, acquired by Navent/QuintoAndar)
founders.background_notes: Second time founder; country manager of Inmuebles24 in Mexico before Pulppo.

investors: Rappi, Kavak and HiHab founders and executives

exit.reason: Habi announced the acquisition to expand in Mexico's resale housing market; founders stay on; price undisclosed.

technical_complexity.rationale: A CRM, listing syndication and valuation tool is standard software; the hard part was operations and agent adoption rather than technology.

defensibility.rationale: Agent community and workflow lock in help, but the tooling itself was copyable and incumbents like portals had distribution.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied it in a documented way; Habi, a Colombian proptech, bought it in early 2026.

market_need_then: Founders cited a large annual commission pool for LATAM brokerages and agents who felt their brokerage brand gave them little, per Bloomberg Linea coverage in 2022. Both founders had built and sold earlier real estate or delivery businesses in the region.

identity.voice_and_tone: Spanish language, professional, positions itself as a regional real estate accelerator

branding.brand_signature: Offers agents a supporting brand and community, not just software
branding.community_and_virality: Agent community is central to the pitch, with about 1,500 to 2,000 advisers cited in later coverage; Habi said Pulppo keeps its identity after the deal.

brand_strength.rationale: Regional recognition among brokers and Latin American startup press, and the brand survives post acquisition, but the double p spelling is unusual and no source shows mass awareness.

outcome_analysis: Pulppo was built by two repeat founders from real estate and delivery who raised a $1.7M pre-seed in February 2022 and about $5M seed by November 2022. It grew a broker network across Mexico, Colombia and Argentina and was acquired by Habi in early 2026 with founders staying, which reads as a positive regional consolidation exit.
notes: No competitor source dated near the batch was found; only aggregator comparison pages (CB Insights lists Mudafy, Ultracasas, others) with no dates, so the list is empty. Seed amount of about 5M comes from Wamda and El Cronista headline and the exact round date is approximate (YC page news dates it Nov 2022; DAAL joined Jan 2023). Acquisition date conflicts: Jan 2026 per CB Insights and StartupResearcher, 2 Mar 2026 per press release. A $2M seed dated Jan 2022 on an aggregator is unverified and not recorded. Gath is also spelled Mathias in one outlet.
